# Croner

Unmodified ESM distribution and MIT license from `croner@10.0.1` on npm.
Upstream: https://github.com/Hexagon/croner

The scheduler uses the upstream parser and calendar implementation. Vendoring
the single generated module preserves the bridge's zero-install Node runtime.
